note: HAND-ASSEMBLED from the tool/extract_component_spec.py --emit-js traversal, because --build refuses this set: 'Material=Acrylic: 2 fills / 1 strokes. The fixture stores one resolved colour each; stacked paints need a richer shape before this component can be extracted.' Every value below is verbatim from that traversal. Two schema fields are therefore null rather than wrong: `fill`, because two stacked translucent paints have no single resolved colour, and `stroke`, because the stroke is a GRADIENT_LINEAR and the extractor's argb() only resolves SOLID paints. Both live in `material` below, which the loader ignores. Order note: Figma paints `fills` in array order, LAST on top — confirmed by rendering node 9114:812 in isolation and sampling the centre pixel, rgba(246,247,250,217), which is Secondary composited under Primary (Primary under Secondary would give rgba(235,239,245,217)).
